why: Tab moves by name from the Command Palette (user 2026-11-11, 'move it to right split'): Move Tab to Pane falls back to a new split at the screen edge, and Move Tab to Window… and Duplicate Tab to New Split get handlers. Each needs AppActionContext, TabMoves, NewAtPlacement, PaneController and revealer, which are all App-only types, so no lower package can hold them. The rows, words and aliases themselves live in the Rust catalog.
